components.meaning: Source-grounded employment, termination, disability or death, retirement, and linked payment episodes for termination-related remuneration clauses.
components.prompt: Read the current facts as a finite source. Use the actual native query only to identify which already fact-supported payment occupies the queried payment role; the query is not evidence that a payment, termination, disability, retirement, plan, date, or clause exists. Return every coherent view of employment-and-payment episodes, preserving employer, worker, employment endpoints, payer, payee, amount, any expressly stated payment date or payment year, termination date, retirement date, disabling or death reason, and causal links stated by the facts. Mark is_query_payment only as a role alignment for a payment independently witnessed in facts. Do not turn an employment or service endpoint into a payment date, invent a plan, decide whether the payment is wages, or decide the statutory clause. Every positive episode needs a nonempty verbatim facts witness. Complete means the whole finite case was inspected; an absent field is null, completed absence is [], and unread extraction is not an empty negative.

components.meaning: Reusable annual income, marriage, return-filing, itemized-deduction, and directed section 151 given observations.
components.prompt: Read the whole current facts and question and return every coherent factual view. Extract annual incomes, marriages, actual joint or separate return statements, itemized-deduction events, and explicit positive or negative section 151(b) or 151(c) givens. Preserve the taxpayer-to-spouse or taxpayer-to-dependent direction and polarity. Represent expressly continuing marriage wording as ongoing_since, a bare marriage commencement as onset_only, and a bounded marriage as closed_interval. A native marriage onset is a valid start event and must not be rejected merely because no end is stated. Do not duplicate records, treat separate filing as a joint-return event, infer an allowance from marriage or kinship, or copy the target section query as a given. Positive records require exact facts witnesses. Complete means every channel in the finite case was read; [] is completed source absence, whereas null/unread is unresolved extraction.

components.meaning: Event-rooted payments linked to source-stated services with correct payer, payee, worker, employer, amount, kind, and dates.
components.prompt: Read only the complete current case and return every coherent payment/service view. Each positive record must identify a distinct service event and linked payment event, preserving literal payer, payee, amount, worker, employer, stated service kind, inclusive service endpoints, and an exact payment date only when expressly supplied. Do not copy a service period into the payment date, allocate cross-year remuneration, total amounts, infer a service kind, or place persons and amounts where event roots belong. Complete finite absence is []; unread or ambiguous extraction is null/unread. Every positive record needs a nonempty verbatim facts witness; the target query may identify roles but cannot establish a payment or service.

components.meaning: Source-only service, educational-institution, enrollment, and class-attendance facts retaining institution identity and time form.
components.prompt: Extract a source-only factual view for student-service questions. Preserve the worker and employing institution of each service, every express school/college/university classification, and separate enrollment and regular-class-attendance states with their person and institution. Mark the source-supported service occupying the native query role with is_query_service; this role marker cannot create a service. Use ongoing_since only for continuing wording, active_on_date only for an expressly dated status, closed_interval only with two endpoints, and onset_only for a bare commencement. Do not infer enrollment from attendance, attendance from enrollment, or institution identity from similar names. Positive records need verbatim facts witnesses. Complete finite absence is []; null/unread preserves extraction uncertainty.

components.meaning: Fact-only marriage starts or intervals and actual deceased-person dates, separated from query roles and legal death-window conclusions.
components.prompt: Extract only current-case marriage and actual death facts. Preserve both spouses, the marriage time form, the deceased person, and the actual death date. A death record must have a nonempty verbatim facts witness: the target question, queried year, or clause name can never establish that the queried taxpayer died. Represent continuing wording as ongoing_since, a bare commencement as onset_only, and a bounded marriage as closed_interval. Lower an onset as the native marriage start without inventing an end or adding a persistence gate. Do not compute a death window, infer surviving-spouse status, duplicate deaths, or close a marriage unless the source expressly supplies its endpoint. Complete finite absence is []; null/unread is unresolved extraction.

components.meaning: Source-only kinship, shared-residence intervals, births, and actual joint-return events for qualifying-child or dependent clauses.
components.prompt: Read the current case and extract only source-stated family relationships, shared-residence periods, births, and actual joint returns. For kinship, preserve the individual bearing the relationship and the person relative to whom it is borne; for example, in 'A has a son B', B is the son and A is relative_to. Preserve every person sharing a stated residence, one common local place identity for that stated home, and exact interval endpoints. Extract a joint return only when the facts expressly say it was joint; marriage alone does not establish one. Do not use the target qualifying-child claim as a relationship, residence, age, or return fact, and do not decide half-year residence or legal qualification. Positive records require facts witnesses. Complete finite absence is []; null/unread is extraction uncertainty.

rationale: 该累计库把历史四类可复用观察与本批三项新事实需求合并为六个源原生组件。它保留事件根、角色方向、极性、有限读取状态和逐记录事实证据；修复原生元数/重复、角色倒置、婚姻起点接口以及“问题生成死亡事实”等已知错误。新加入的终止付款和亲属共同居所组件标为 source-only，未冒充错误学习。规划器只按实际原生查询选择必要组件；绑定器不读取 TRAIN 答案、不判断法律结论，也不从目标问题生成正面事件。两组共同修正后均为 4/4，因此本库不主张方法优势。
